title: (RHEA-2018:2125) Removal of Fuse 7.0 Technical Preview Images
portal_summary:
This errata is for the removal of the Technical Preview of Fuse 7.0.

The Tech Preview is now superseded by the GA release of Fuse 7.0 as detailed in RHBA-2018:1693-04.

IMPORTANT: Please upgrade your builds to the GA images as soon as possible, the Technical Preview images will be removed on 5th July 2018.
portal_synopsis: Removal of Fuse 7.0 Technical Preview Images
portal_product_filter: Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|Red Hat OpenShift Container Platform|3.7|x86_64
portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description: This advisory removes the Technical Preview images for Fuse on OpenShift (previously called Fuse Integration Services) and Fuse Online. These images are part of Red Hat Fuse 7.0.0.
